text.name: Winged Sandals
text.description:
{Winged Sandals}

Give all friendly creatures +1 speed.
text.event: While trying to shoot game for dinner, you came across two strange birds fluttering in the treetops. You immediately shot them down with well-aimed shots. Already looking forward to a hearty dinner, you discovered that instead of birds you had knocked down a pair of Winged Sandals. You're so lucky!
